Why Mobile Home Parks?

Investors in today's landscape have never faced more uncertainty. It can be overwhelming to assess what asset classes are reliable and deliver solid returns.

Mobile home parks represent one of the most resilient and recession-resistant asset classes in real estate. With housing affordability at crisis levels, manufactured housing provides essential shelter for millions of American families.

Ethics First

Committed to ethical investing that benefits residents and investors alike.

Strong Returns

Consistent cash flow with potential for significant appreciation through value-add strategies.

Recession Resistant

Affordable housing demand remains strong regardless of economic conditions.

Community Impact

We improve lives by upgrading infrastructure and creating vibrant communities.

Experienced Team

Our leadership has decades of real estate and operations experience.

Our Founding Team

It's in our name. We are devoted Patriots who create value with our Partners. Our team focuses on delivering returns for our Investors through fair treatment, responsive management, reliable communication, and continuous improvement in every community we operate.

Jordan Rahal

Co-Founder and Lead

Native of Illinois, served on active duty as a commissioned Marine Corps Officer from 2008-2012, deploying to Afghanistan in 2010 as a combat advisor to the Afghan Border Police. After leaving active duty, transitioned to the Reserves where he has remained actively serving since. Jordan attended graduate school at Duke University before working on Wall Street and then Strategy Consulting for 5 years followed by the Food Distribution and Logistics industries. Active Real Estate investor in multiple markets and states with focuses on value-add investing strategies. Above all else, devoted Husband, Father and Practicing Roman Catholic.

Jared Martin

Co-Founder, Operations

Jared is true expert in Single Family, Multifamily and Mobile Home Park Real Estate investing. Jared has been in the industry for over 20 years, starting out doing contracting work on small flips and developing a thriving contracting business, executing over 50 rehabs for investors and dozens for himself as Real Estate Investor. Jared expanded into the Property Management space, managing over 120 doors actively on behalf of investors as well as self-managing his own properties as CEO of 3rd Son Properties. Jared holds an MS in organizational leadership from WGU. Jared is the son of a Preacher, proud husband and father.

Jeremy Taylor

Co-Founder, Investor Relations and Sales

Jeremy and Jordan go back 18+ years, having gone through Marine Corps Officer Candidate School, The Basic School and MOS school together, as well as serendipitously meeting up in Afghanistan in 2010. Jeremy is a graduate from UC-Davis and commissioned in the Marine Corps in 2008 as a reservist. In his "civilian career" Jeremy went to Silicon Valley and cut his teeth in sales for various software businesses, becoming a top-producer at several firms. During this time he learned Real Estate from the ground-up (literally) by doing his first deal as a house-hack. He entered the wholesaling business and has closed 50+ transactions. Over time through sweat and grit, Jeremy quickly developed a successful portfolio of investment properties and was able to transition to becoming a full-time Real Estate investor and is incredibly excited about bringing in investors into Mobile Home Park investing.

Our Investment Process

We follow a disciplined, proven process to identify, acquire, and improve mobile home communities—creating value for residents and investors alike.

01

Strategic Acquisition

We identify underperforming mobile home parks in strong markets with value-add potential. Our rigorous due diligence ensures every investment meets our strict criteria.

02

Community Transformation

We invest in infrastructure improvements, professional management, and community upgrades to enhance both resident experience and property value.

03

Value Creation

Through operational excellence and strategic capital improvements, we increase occupancy, reduce expenses, and grow net operating income.

04

Investor Returns

Our investors receive regular distributions from cash flow and participate in appreciation upon sale or refinance of the asset.

Transparent and Hands-On

Our approach goes beyond financial returns. When we acquire a community, we invest in infrastructure, management, and amenities that make a real difference in residents' daily lives.

  • Upgraded roads, utilities, and common areas
  • Professional, responsive on-site management
  • Community events and resident engagement programs
  • Safe, clean, and welcoming environments
